audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill on all seven rows while the content layer and packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Skill/Karma/Karma. Five rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: Inner Flame reaches 950 against Bouncing Bomb's 850, and Satchel Charge does not exist at level 1, so the early rows are genuinely Karma's. Levels 4-5 and 6 are even — Mega Inferno Bomb at 120s is a siege tool, not a lane kill threat. Late, Karma's peel beats an immobile poke mage, which whys[6] and spikes[3] already argue.
audit.corrected: Full-layer rows 0, 1, 2, 5 and 6 moved to Karma with all seven whys reground on the real ranges and cooldowns.
sources: enemyKit Q range 850, W cd 20/18/16/14/12, R cd 120/95/70

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item whys were the generic Karma template and never named Mega Inferno Bomb or its cooldown.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s from 5000 range — it threatens sieges and objectives, not lane duels, which is exactly why level 6 stays even.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the 120s and the 5000 range and says Karma answers it with shields, not damage; phases[5].why keys her item spike to Satchel Charge still being 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No interaction was stated anywhere; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); wants.foe[1] called Satchel Charge his E, and several content fields referred to a 'Q-E poke' combo.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is the W; Hexplosive Minefield is the E, a flat 16 seconds at 900 range that slows. Karma's E is Inspiration, a pure shield that deals no damage, so 'Q-E poke' describes an ability she does not have. The real trap is walking over the minefield to reach him: the slow holds you there for Bouncing Bomb plus his Short Fuse empowered auto.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, 'Q-E poke' removed, and breakdown.cooldowns now carries Satchel Charge 20s/12s, Minefield 16s, Bouncing Bomb 6s and Mega Inferno Bomb 120s.
sources: enemyKit W/E slots, cds and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted under 'Q-poke the last-hits relentlessly'; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad under 'Trade at his range once items arrive' (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The margin in this lane is 100 units of range — 950 against 850 — and that is what both bullets should say.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten around that 100-unit gap and the 900-range minefield.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Karma: your Q-E poke combo trades better than Ziggs's single-target bomb harass, and your mana efficiency lets you contest lane longer without back timers. Ziggs has no way to punish your range advantage directly, so he's forced into a passive farming pattern behind minions. Levels 4-5 tighten into a skill matchup as Ziggs's damage output scales up and satchel-charge combos become real all-in threats, meaning careful positioning around minion wave state matters more than raw poke exchanges.
